NOTICE UNDER THE REGISTRATION OF ELECTORS ACT, No. 44 OF 1980 AS AMENDED
BY THE REGISTRATION OFELECTORS (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 27 OF 2013
Electoral District No. 10 - Jaffna

NOTICE is hereby given under Section 4 of the Registration of Electors Act, No. 44 of 1980 as amended by the Registration ofElectors (Special Provisions) Act, No. 27 of 2013 that the supplementary register of internally displaced electors in relation tothe aforementioned Electoral District was certified and is being exhibited during office hours for perusal at the DistrictElections Office, Jaffna.
